properties.description: At every eligible pre and post observation, fill equals independently modeled occupancy. Acceptance uses expected pre-edge occupancy: full rejects writes and empty rejects reads, including simultaneous requests.
Full is known and asserted exactly when the independently expected queue contains sixteen words.
Empty is known and asserted exactly when the independently expected queue contains zero words.

Whenever the expected queue is nonempty, asynchronous front data equals the oldest accepted word. Checks ordering, preservation, simultaneous transfers, wraparound, rejected operations, and reset recovery; empty data is unconstrained.
Public status is known and consistent: fill is within zero through sixteen, full is equivalent to fill sixteen, and empty is equivalent to fill zero.
After each synchronous reset edge and until the next edge, fill is zero, full is low, and empty is high. The independent queue discards all earlier words on reset.
